methodology: All 708 comments semantically classified (4 parallel passes with the recall-sharpened vacuous-cheer definition from the Argon analysis, so no separate recall pass was needed), then author-level affiliation propagation (affiliated_author, pre_disclosure), a rescan of unflagged comments by flagged authors, and cross-thread repeat-offender matching against HN/50073879 (Gemini 4 Argon). repeat_argon_flag = author was pattern-flagged in the Argon thread two weeks earlier. Categories flag rhetorical patterns, not proof of bot or shill behavior. Account age/karma from public HN profiles 2026-10-29.

comparison_with_argon_thread.note: Carbon drew roughly half the cheer/boost volume of Argon with ~86% of the comments; thread skewed critical (announce-without-release, benchmark cherrypicking).
